products.description: Licensed Toyota Land Cruiser LC80 Body – Scale-accurate design with rich detailing,2-Speed Transmission – Switch between low torque crawling and higher speed driving,4WD Drivetrain – Strong traction and stability across rocky and uneven terrain,Oil-Filled Shock Absorbers – Smooth suspension performance with excellent impact absorption,4-Link Suspension System – Enhances balance, climbing ability and control,Metal Gear Steering Servo – Provides durability and precise steering response,Smart LED Lighting System – Realistic headlights for visibility and scale appearance,Metal Connecting Rods & Bearings – Boost stability and reduce drivetrain noise,Compact Yet Powerful – Lightweight 535g build with excellent climbing angles.

products.name: Panther
products.description: The HNR H9802 Panther is a 1/10 scale professional-grade drift and on-road RC car, engineered for speed, precision, and style. Featuring a powerful Hobbywing brushless motor and ESC combo, and a 2.4GHz remote system, this Panther is built for competitive drifting and high-speed racing. With a striking red body design, it’s as aggressive in looks as it is in performance.

products.name: Ford F-100
products.description: The F-100 is particularly suitable for beginners thanks to its straightforward drivetrain and durable construction. The adjustable wheelie bar also allows drivers to tune the truck for different driving styles and control rear-wheel lift during hard acceleration.

products.name: Hyper Go
products.description: Built for both rally driving and controlled drifting, the Hyper Go 10303 combines aggressive styling with durable construction and responsive handling. Its 4WD drivetrain ensures excellent traction across pavement, gravel, and drift surfaces, while the brushless power system provides rapid acceleration and strong top-end speed.

products.name: Truggy
products.description: The HS14321 RC Truggy is a versatile off-road and drift-ready model designed for RC enthusiasts who want speed, stability, and durability in one package. Powered by a high-performance motor and supported by a 2.4 GHz radio system, this truggy reaches speeds of up to 40 km/h, delivering thrilling performance for beginners and hobbyists alike.

products.name: H1 HURTLE
products.description: The JJRC Q121 is a durable and versatile 1/12 scale 4WD RC off-road truck designed for adventure, stability, and long-lasting fun. Powered by a 370 brushed motor with high torque and Its robust build, metal reinforcements, and waterproof design make it perfect for tackling rough terrain while maintaining excellent handling.

products.name: Power Wagon RTR
products.description: The FMS FCX24 Power Wagon is a meticulously designed 1:24 scale crawler, redefining what small-scale climbing RC cars can achieve. Inspired by the classic 1949 Power Wagon mud off-road truck, this model blends authentic retro styling with cutting-edge RC engineering.

products.name: ENOZE
products.description: The ENOZE 8500 / 8501 1:43 RC Drift Car is a compact yet powerful mini drift vehicle designed for high-speed fun and precise control. With a durable PVC explosion-proof shell, realistic LED lights, and a smooth 2WD system, this desktop racer delivers an exciting drift experience for both kids and RC enthusiasts.

products.name: MAX SMASHER
products.description: The FMS FCX24 Max Smasher is a 1/24 scale 4WD climbing RC pickup truck built for performance and realism. Powered by a 2S battery system, this compact crawler combines strong torque, durable suspension, and precise control with an authentic scale design. Whether indoors or outdoors, the Max Smasher delivers stable off-road climbing, flexible handling, and detailed simulation styling, making it perfect for hobbyists, collectors, and RC enthusiasts.

products.name: BMW
products.description: Ghost clocks up to 20 km/h, giving you high-speed thrills in a sleek, low-profile body.Smooth digital steering and responsive throttle for tight turns and clean slides

products.name: Lambo
products.description: Bring home the thrill of racing with this Lifelong Cuppy Raptor RC Car in striking Black & Red. Equipped with a 2.4 GHz long-range remote (125+ ft), multi-directional drift capabilities, and realistic LED headlights, it’s built for fun, day or night.

products.name: Cuppy
products.description: Lifelong Cuppy Monster Drift Car gives kids fast, exciting spins and smooth drifting action on any surface. With its sturdy build and easy controls, it’s perfect for fun races and cool stunt play. A great pick for kids who love speed, slides, and adventure.

products.name: Rocker
products.description: Full Direction Control – Easily move forward, backward, left, and right with responsive handling., Long-Range Signal Response – Maintains stable control from a good distance without lag., One-Hand Easy Controller – Ergonomic remote designed for comfortable grip and simple operation., Quick Response Steering – Immediate turning action for precise off-road maneuvering.
